# TrainLens 0.16.1 — clearer LLM and agent workflows

TrainLens 0.16.1 simplifies the README and makes the three supported workflows explicit from the start.

## Highlights

- put the end-to-end Colab quickstart notebook at the top of the README
- distinguish local deterministic analysis, Agent Mode, and direct LLM reports
- clarify that Agent Mode can use any LLM/provider available to the surrounding agent
- explain that Claude, Codex, Cursor, or another host agent normally owns that LLM connection, avoiding duplicate provider configuration inside TrainLens
- make clear that Agent Mode is optional: TrainLens can still call an OpenAI-compatible provider directly for generated reports, diagnoses, and improvement ideas
- shorten the README substantially and focus it on the main usage paths

No Agent Mode API behavior changes in this patch; this release clarifies how the existing capabilities fit together.
